title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Students
description: GitHub introduced a new GitHub Copilot Student plan, rebranding the free tier to create a long-term, sustainable Copilot experience tailored specifically for students. Starting March 12, 2026, students with GitHub Education benefits are transitioned to this new plan.

community_feedback.quote: They're rebranding the free tier as the 'GitHub Copilot Student' plan, which is just the budget version
GitHub is just trying to save costs; the student plan is now the same as the free version available to everyone
Discussion about potential 40-50% discount on Copilot Pro for students instead of full free access
Multiple 'goodbye github copilot' posts suggest user dissatisfaction with the changes

title: Custom Chart Creation Feature
description: Anthropic announced that Claude can now create custom charts, expanding the tool's data visualization capabilities for developers using Claude Code. This update enables interactive charts, diagrams and visualizations directly in the coding workflow.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is going mega viral on X
Claude Code is going crazy viral again. People are coming up with wild use cases
4% of GitHub public commits are being authored by Claude Code, projected to reach 20%+ of all daily commits by end of 2026
Many pointed out that Claude could already generate the code for these charts; this just renders it directly
The Claude Code TUI app is pretty solid. I use it heavily and get great results
